quote: This evidence is corroborated when we excluded the chemical cues, focusing exclusively on the visual sense (T2), in which the jar containing anchovy was selected in only 50% of the cases.
note: Page read through the fetch tool, which returned the sentence in quoted form; Sentence relayed in two parts and joined.  The negative control T5 (no vision and no chemosensory cue) showed no difference in jar choice, so 50% is the visual-only value against that baseline. The paper gives no number of jars per trial and no chance level, so 50% cannot be placed against chance from the text; the Results call T2 'a significant decrease in recognition' without a task-level statistic. Fixed order of the first two tests and reuse of the four animals across tasks allow order effects.
